description: One report for a device across several target countries: where it works as is, where it needs attention (with the indoor-coverage risk when a network's own coverage band is missing) and where it does not work, plus a link to the full report on the website (PDF, share link, ask an engineer to confirm).

countries.description: ISO codes or country names (English or Chinese), up to 30

device.description: Device id or name, for example mf833v, EG25-G, Quectel BG77

name: project_report
title: Project report for several countries
